data.receiver_enabled: Receive reports from the panel (SIA/Contact ID)
data.save_images: Save camera pictures in Home Assistant

data_description.scan_interval: Choose 0.5-3600 seconds. The panel receives two parallel page requests per poll.
data_description.event_interval: How often the event log and report list (alarm cause, battery, tamper) are read. They are also read at once when the arm state or a zone changes.
data_description.receiver_enabled: Home Assistant listens for alarm reports that the panel pushes at once. Set a free slot under Rapport indst. to ip://ACCOUNT@HA-IP:PORT/CID_SIA. Do not change slots used by TrueConnect or a monitoring centre.
data_description.receiver_port: The TCP port Home Assistant listens on. Only the panel's own IP address may connect.
data_description.receiver_account: Must match the account number in the report slot. Empty accepts any account from the panel.
data_description.auto_backup: Saves the panel configuration (cfg.bin) in /config/trueguard_mz/backups every 30 days and keeps the 12 newest. The file contains codes; do not share it.
data_description.save_images: Saves every new PIR-camera picture in /media/trueguard_mz, because the panel keeps only the 10 newest.
